name: Redberry Juniper
caution: A seasoning in tiny amounts only; not a food, and unsafe in quantity. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Unlike its blue-fruited cousins, this West Texas juniper carries coppery-red berries.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: Same rule as any juniper: a pinch of crushed berry for aroma, nothing more.
